thr: byte b -> 4 + b/10 degrees latitude; 255 = not drawn
mask: byte -> desert weight 0..1 (Natural Earth SAHARA, blurred ~0.6 deg, land only)

front.full_source: Tierney, Pausata & deMenocal 2017, Science Advances 3, e1601503: the Green Sahara extended to 31 N

trim: desert weight fades to 0 between 16.5 and 14.5 N (the polygon runs into the Sahel)
drawn: THR = latitude - up to 2.0 deg over ground above 500 m (full at 2,000 m) - up to 1.2 deg along valleys + smooth noise +-0.8 deg. A drawing, not a reconstruction.
sources: Natural Earth 10m geography regions (public domain), polygon SAHARA
